audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer refers to Cassiopeia as "he/his/him" across tldr, phases, trading, don'ts and the report, and never names why the early lane is yours.
audit.why: Cassiopeia is female, and the reason Akshan owns levels 1-5 is mechanical: she cannot buy boots and has no dash, so boomerang range and the Dirty Fighting second shot are free chip she cannot close on.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed and the early-lane stages now say what actually wins them; the Skill split from level 6 onward matches both the content layer and the Cassiopeia-side mirror.

audit.why: Spikes are right on both sides: Akshan at level 2-3 and at Youmuu's, Cassiopeia at Petrifying Gaze (120/100/80) and at her two-item Liandry's/Rylai's DPS ramp. The content layer already carries all four.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer described Miasma only as "grounds you — dashes and leaps are disabled inside it" and never connected it to Heroic Swing, nor gave its cooldown; Petrifying Gaze's facing requirement was absent from the Level 6 stage.
audit.why: Miasma (W, 24/22/20/18/16s) is the grounding that kills Heroic Swing, which is Akshan's only exit — that is the single decisive interaction. Petrifying Gaze (R, 120/100/80) stuns only a target facing her, which is what makes level 6 survivable.
audit.corrected: Miasma is now named with its 24s rank-1 cooldown and tied explicitly to the swing; Level 6 now states the facing rule so the stage's Skill rating is earned rather than asserted.
